1. Products & Services
THAI TEA HOUSE offers authentic Thai milk tea, Thai Tea Coffee, and Thai Tea Coconut, with different sweetness levels and toppings to suit customers’ preferences.
2. History & Milestones
THAI TEA HOUSE was created to introduce the unique taste of Thai tea to international customers. Its next milestone is expanding into the Vietnamese market.
3. Goals
The company aims to become a popular Thai tea brand in Vietnam through social media marketing, new products, and regular promotions.
4. Customers & Markets
Its target customers are students, teenagers, young adults, and tourists in Vietnam, especially those who enjoy trendy drinks and new flavors.
5. What Makes It Different
The brand combines authentic Thai flavors with customizable sweetness levels, a variety of toppings, and creative fusion drinks.
6. Numbers That Changed
80–120 baht per cup: the planned price range.
10,000 to 100,000 followers: the TikTok growth target within six months.

Company Name: Siam Delicious
Products & Services: Siam Delicious sells popular Thai dishes, including Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup, and Green Curry. We use fresh ingredients and traditional Thai recipes to provide delicious meals at affordable prices.
History & Milestones: Siam Delicious was founded in 2023 to share authentic Thai food with more customers. In 2024, we expanded our menu from 10 to 15 dishes.
Goals: Our goal is to become a popular Thai food brand in Thailand by offering high-quality food, friendly service, and reasonable prices.
Customers & Markets: Our target customers are students, office workers, and tourists who enjoy Thai food. We aim to reach more customers through social media and new restaurant branches.
What Makes It Different: We combine authentic Thai flavors, fresh ingredients, traditional recipes, affordable prices, and friendly service to create a great dining experience.

Company Name: Six Seven Cloth

1. Products & Services: We sell fashionable clothes for young people, including T-shirts, shirts, jeans, skirts, and jackets.

2. History & Milestones: Six Seven Cloth was created to provide trendy and affordable clothing for young people.

3. Goals: Our goal is to offer good-quality clothes at reasonable prices and make customers feel confident and comfortable.

4. Customers & Markets: Our target customers are teenagers and young adults who enjoy fashionable clothes. We sell both online and at our store.

5. What Makes It Different: We offer various styles, comfortable materials, affordable prices, and a relaxing shopping atmosphere.

6. Numbers That Changed: Our goal is to increase online sales by 20% and attract more customers in the future.

BURGER QUEEN offers delicious and affordable burgers, French fries, chicken, and refreshing drinks. We have many choices for our customers.

BURGER QUEEN is a local fast-food chain. We focus on delicious food, affordable prices, and good quality.

Our goal is to become a popular fast-food brand. We want to provide good food and make our customers happy.

Our main customers are teenagers, students, families, and working people. They want convenient, tasty, and affordable meals.
